items.problem: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1's manifest healthcheck (section 5b) reports PASS based only on TargetDeviceFamily/rescap/runFullTrust, giving a false sense that the manifest is launch-ready when an unsupported <Extensions> entry will block registration.
items.evidence: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 lines 331-371 check only those three things and print '[PASS] Package.appxmanifest — Windows.Desktop target + rescap:runFullTrust capability declared'; the AdvancedCasting manifest passed yet failed to launch (migration-score.json winui_launchable:false).
items.covered_at: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 section '5b. Package.appxmanifest WinUI 3 packaging requirements' (lines 331-371) and MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Manifest migration checklist (Windows.Desktop + runFullTrust)' (lines 458-490).
items.proposed_improvement: Extend the EXISTING section 5b manifest check (and the matching checklist prose) to also assert the manifest carries no UWP-only <Extensions> categories, so the existing '[PASS] manifest' signal genuinely means launch-ready rather than only covering the three capability checks.
items.generalizes: The validator is the agent's last gate before declaring done; broadening its single manifest check to the most common registration-blocking class makes every migration's PASS signal trustworthy.
